issues.explanation: Chapter 31 returns to an earlier point by saying Cao Cao advances on Guandu in Jian'an 8 after Chapter 30 has already covered the Guandu campaign and its aftermath, including Yuan Shao's flight across the river.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove or reframe the Jian'an 8 Guandu advance as a later, clearly distinct event, or end Chapter 31 before this retrospective/repeated campaign.

issues.explanation: The renewed march to Guandu and Yuan Shao's illness/son taking command repeat the already completed Guandu conflict and create an unclear second version of the same campaign.
issues.suggested_fix: Link the illness and Yuan Shang's command directly to the next distinct campaign, or omit the repeated Guandu setup.
